info.title: Official public statistics behind the practice and state pages: bankruptcy, employment, immigration and personal injury: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Official public statistics behind the practice and state pages: bankruptcy, employment, immigration and personal injury: Every official figure quoted on our bankruptcy, employment-law, immigration and personal-injury pages for ten states, one sentence per record, with the federal source it comes from (U.S. Courts, EEOC, the immigration courts and NHTSA's fatal-crash file) and the page it appears on.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
